task.title: Produce publication copies of media carrying the company's own brand
task.input: The original desktop JPG/GIF/video files, the current PackJoyU wordmark and the asset provenance register
task.output: Publishable JPG/GIF still frames and video posters/compressed copies, hashes and a frame-by-frame verification report
task.accept: 1) The original file hashes must remain unchanged; replace the old logo in the JPG and every old-logo appearance, perspective and reappearance after occlusion across all 361 GIF frames with the company's own wordmark; frame presentation times, order and the 30.08-second loop must remain unchanged; any missed logo or newly introduced misalignment excludes the publication copy from finished deliverables (E-26, E-28, E-30). 2) When GPT Dot is available, retain evidence of remote software operations and files; when unavailable, explicitly record the unperformed work and its asset task; finished deliverables must have provenance/comparison evidence and a usable poster, without claiming the invocation succeeded (E-29).
